subject: CALL statement
notes: Re-derived independently at 14.9.4.4 2) ('FORMATS 1 AND 2'), incl. the NOTE and the pointer to 14.2; citation validated (`cite.py --check 14.9.4.4 "This correspondence is positional and not by name equivalence."` -> OK, General rules 2). || UPHELD, with the read redone on BOTH sides rather than the callee alone. CALLEE side: DataBinder.CallBindLinkage walks `pd.usingClause().usingParameter()` with a local `int pos = 0` incremented once per parameter - including on BOTH error arms (the OPTIONAL loud stage and the COBOL0888 'not a level-01/77 LINKAGE item' arm both fall through to `pos++`), so a diagnosed formal cannot silently shift the slots of the ones after it; `pos` is the PROCEDURE DIVISION USING order, NOT the LINKAGE declaration order, which is what the rule names. ProgramEmitter.EmitCallMethod then materializes every formal as `CobolArgAdapt.Num/Text/NumValue/TextValue(__args, f.Position, ...)` and guards copy-in/copy-out with `CobolArgAdapt.Present(__args, f.Position)` - a bare integer index. CALLER side: CallBinder.BindCall's `foreach (var a in call.callUsingPhrase().callArgument())` adds exactly zero-or-one BoundCallArg per node and I checked every arm for a SILENT skip (the classic positional-shift shape): `callArgument : callByReference | callByValue | callByContent | dataReference` has exactly four alternatives and all four are handled; every unresolvable operand returns BoundUnsupported/BoundNop for the WHOLE statement rather than dropping one argument. The ABI makes name equivalence structurally impossible: `ICobolProgram.Call(CobolArg[] args, ManagedPointer? returning)` (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Control/CallAbi.cs) carries an ORDERED array of `CobolArg(Mode, Carrier, Digits, Scale)` with no name field, and nothing in CallBinder consults the callee's header. Both halves of the rule therefore rest on a read of the actual index arithmetic, not on 'looks right'. Test caveat recorded rather than hidden: NEITHER cited golden would fail if the order were reversed - pb46_call_format2_as_nested passes ONE argument per CALL (caller N -> formal P, which pins the not-by-name half only) and 2002/goback_returning's two arguments feed a commutative COMPUTE (40+2, 7+6). The multi-argument ORDER witness exists only as CallDifferentialTests.CallUsing_CorrespondenceIsPositionalNotByName, which routes through DifferentialGolden.Assert (a legacy-oracle-BAKED golden), so it is non-qualifying and is not cited; a swapped-name, non-commutative two-argument golden would close it. Also noted while reading, NOT charged to this rule: 14.2.2 SR1's 'A particular user-defined word shall not appear more than once as data-name-1' is unchecked, and a repeated formal would overwrite `item.CsName = carrier + ".Value"` so both slots read the last carrier - illegal source, an SR row (14.9.4.3 / 14.2.2), outside this part. Editions: no Annex E delta (E.2's only CALL entry is the ON OVERFLOW removal); batch default.
